analysis.title: Instacart (CART) Q3'26 Earnings Review
key_insights: Instacart reported Q3'26 GTV of $10.528bn, up 15% y/y and accelerating, versus the GS estimate of $10.366bn and consensus of $10.467bn. The company's guide was $10.30-10.425bn.

Q3'26 revenue was $1,095mm, 2% above both the GS estimate ($1,072mm) and consensus ($1,071mm). Ads and other revenue was $331mm, 5% above both GS and consensus, and transaction revenue was $764mm, 1% above.
Q3'26 adjusted EBITDA was $342mm, 3% above both GS ($332mm) and consensus ($333mm), and above the company guide of $320-340mm. Adj. EBITDA margin was 3.2% of GTV and 31.2% of revenue.
Gross margin was 71.8% of revenue, 61bps below the GS estimate and 192bps below consensus. Gross profit of $786mm was 1% above GS and 0% versus consensus.
Orders were 91.4mm, in line with GS and consensus. The GTV beat came from AOV of $115 versus $113 (GS) and $114 (consensus).
Separately from the earnings report, Instacart announced a definitive agreement to be acquired by DoorDash in a cash and stock transaction at an equity value of $17bn.

GS sees online grocery as in the early innings, with online penetration well below overall eCommerce. GS expects investment in fulfillment networks, inventory digitization and in-store price parity/discounts, plus tech advances, to drive further adoption.
GS raised Q4'26 estimates to GTV of $11.00bn (from $10.95bn), revenue of $1.12bn (from $1.11bn) and adj. EBITDA of $351mm (from $349mm). Q4'26 GAAP EPS was cut to $0.50 from $0.65.
GS raised 2027 estimates to GTV of $46.74bn (from $46.48bn), revenue of $4.80bn (from $4.78bn) and adj. EBITDA of $1.49bn (from $1.47bn). 2027 GAAP EPS moved to $2.68 from $2.70.

GS is Not Rated on CART with no price target. The rating and estimates are removed per GS policy because GS is acting as financial advisor on the announced strategic matter involving Maplebear Inc. The stock was $58.42 at the 28 Oct 2026 close.

market_movers.rationale: GS is Not Rated on CART because it is advising on the DoorDash acquisition. The report updates estimates only and carries no rating or price target.

sector_views.rationale: GS sees online grocery in the early innings of scaling, with penetration well below overall eCommerce, and expects industry investment in fulfillment, inventory digitization and promotions to speed consumer adoption.

Instacart Q3'26 reported adj. EBITDA $342mm vs GS est $332mm, consensus est $333mm and company guide $320-340mm. Reported gross margin 71.8% of revenue vs GS est 72.4% and consensus est 73.7%.
Instacart Q3'26 reported ads and other revenue $331mm vs GS est $314mm and consensus est $315mm. Reported take rate 10.4% vs GS est 10.3% and consensus est 10.2%.

GS FY2026E diluted EPS $2.11 (from $2.26), FY2027E $2.68 (from $2.70), FY2028E $3.21 (from $3.19). These are GS estimates, not reported figures.
